facts.fact: KPT model alleles and Cre driver
facts.value: Ptf1aCreERTM/+; KrasLSL-G12D/+; Trp53LSL-R270H/+; Rosa26LSL-mCL/LSL-mCL on C57BL/6j; Cre is tamoxifen-inducible and active in adult acinar cells; mice injected with tamoxifen at 4-5 weeks of age. The paper writes the p53 allele as R270H.

facts.fact: Latency / median survival of KPT mice
facts.value: Median survival 219 days after tamoxifen (n = 8 KPT; 3 male, 5 female); tumours reached humane endpoint at roughly 6 months

Littermates with Ptf1a+/+ (no Cre) and the same Kras/Trp53 lox-stop alleles, injected with tamoxifen, developed no pancreatic tumours (n = 9) over up to one year, and 3-month sections look like normal acinar tissue

facts.fact: How KPT tumours look on H&E
facts.value: Infiltrating glands that range from well to poorly formed, with marked nuclear atypia and many mitoses; a strong desmoplastic reaction in the invaded pancreas, peripancreatic fat and duodenal wall. The abstract calls the tumours highly differentiated and fibrotic.
Macroscopic metastases at necropsy: liver in 3 of 8 mice, lungs in 1 of 8

facts.fact: ADM and PanIN appear before tumours in KPT mice
facts.value: Three months after tamoxifen, KPT pancreas showed acinar-to-ductal metaplasia (black arrows) and a PanIN lesion (red arrow) in an inflamed stroma; the Cre-negative KP controls did not (n = 6 KPT, n = 7 KP). Alcian blue-positive (mucin) area rose over 1, 2 and 3 months after tamoxifen.
The paper reports that regions of ADM carry deposits of the matrix component hyaluronan and sit next to activated stellate cells (alpha-SMA positive)

Mice aged 6-8 weeks received eight hourly intraperitoneal injections of caerulein (50 ug/kg) on each of two consecutive days; controls got PBS; pancreas collected from 6 h to 8 weeks after the last injection

Early (6 h to 2 d) acinar cells express high clusterin and some become amylase-positive/K19-positive ADM lesions; by 10 days most tissue has recovered normal acini (arrows in the 2 d and 4 d H&E panels mark recovered acini).
Acute pancreatitis targets acinar cells and leads to acinar-ductal metaplasia, inflammation and fibrosis, events that can lead into the earliest stages of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
Mist1 transcription and protein fall sharply while acinar cells undergo ADM and are restored on recovery; the H&E panels shown come from Mist1CreERT/+ heterozygotes

Ptf1aCre/+;LSL-KrasG12D/+ mice. The authors chose Ptf1a-Cre because Pdx1-Cre (active from embryonic day 8.5) gave non-pancreatic tumours in published work and in their hands, while Ptf1a (from day 9.5) restricts tumours to the pancreas

facts.fact: PanIN grades as the paper describes them
facts.value: PanIN-1A: flat, basally placed nuclei in columnar cells with mucin. PanIN-1B: like 1A but papillary or pseudostratified. PanIN-2: flat or papillary with abnormal nuclei but no cribriforming or luminal necrosis. PanIN-3: papillary with cribriform lumen and loss of nuclear polarity.
facts.where: Introduction (cites Pancreatic Cancer Think Tank classification, Table 1)

facts.value: The authors note that many lesions do not fit neatly into one PanIN class and that pathologists disagree, which is the reason for the atlas

Acinar cells lose their zymogen granules and the acinar tissue transforms into duct-like structures; the authors say the ADM route to PanIN is gaining acceptance next to the older ductal-epithelium origin, and that not all PanIN may come from ADM; the lining cells of the duct-like structures are often graded with the PanIN schemes

Over 1000 mice, ages 5-16 months; 24 per sex per age for both study and control groups; control mouse means both Kras and Cre are absent; atlas decks at 5, 11 and 15 months with nine study mice and one control each, images at 4x, 10x, 20x, 40x and 60x
KPIC = LSL-KrasG12D; LSL-Trp53R172H/+; Ink4flox/+; Ptf1/p48-Cre. KIC = Ptf1/p48-Cre; LSL-KrasG12D; Ink4flox/flox. The paper says KPC mice carry KrasG12D, Trp53R172H and Pdx1-Cre.
Palpable hard masses at about 7 weeks in KPIC mice; mean survival 89 days for KPIC versus 62 days for KIC (about 3 months for KPIC)

facts.fact: Histology of KPIC and KIC tumours
facts.value: Both show typical ductal adenocarcinoma in which tumour cells grow as ducts inside dense desmoplastic stroma; in 5 KPIC mice, 3 had typical ductal adenocarcinoma and 2 had high-grade PanIN, all rich in desmoplastic stroma, similar to the well-differentiated adenocarcinoma seen in KIC. KPIC tumours resemble human pancreatic cancer in rich stroma and low microvascularity.

No liver metastases were seen in KPIC mice; local invasion of neighbouring organs (intestine, kidney) occurred and one mouse had a spinal-cord tumour; the authors cite that KPC tumours often metastasise

In Ptf1aCreERT; KrasLSL-G12D pancreas, normal acinar tissue and PanIN were compared by H&E; PTF1A protein, abundant in acinar nuclei, is lost in mouse PanIN epithelium and, with rare exceptions, in human PanIN
facts.where: Fig 1 legend; Abstract; Fig 1-figure supplement 1 legend

facts.fact: Wild-type control for tamoxifen and pancreatitis
facts.value: High-dose tamoxifen in wild-type mice (fixed 24 h later) did not cause pancreatitis: H&E acini, islet and ducts looked like corn-oil or untreated controls, scale bars 200 um (low) and 100 um (high power)
Caerulein 0.1 ug/g i.p. eight times daily for two consecutive days, vehicle saline; pancreas harvested 1 week after the last injection
In Pdx1-Cre; KrasLSL-G12D (KC) mice PanIN are usually minimal at 1 month of age; Ptf1a heterozygosity increased PanIN burden (Alcian blue) at that age

facts.fact: Liver metastases in KPC with Ptf1a heterozygosity
facts.value: The paper documents liver metastases (CLDN18 immunostaining) in KPC mice heterozygous for Ptf1a
Pdx1-Cre mice with wild-type EHMT2 had normal pancreatic structure and histology at 10 days and at 4-6 weeks

Pdx1-Cre; LSL-KrasG12D (and P48Cre/+; LSL-KrasG12D) pancreas shows acinar tubular complexes, atypical flat lesions, ADM and PanIN, which were scored by two pathologists blinded to genotype; cohorts were sacrificed at 4, 6 or 8 weeks
At 8 weeks, 100% of Pdx1-Cre; KrasG12D animals had polymorphonuclear leukocytes or histiocytes in the pancreas (33.3% when EHMT2 was deleted)
Caerulein 50 ug/kg i.p. once a day, five days a week, for 4 weeks from 4 weeks of age, then 7 days recovery before sacrifice

facts.fact: PanIN at 3 months in a KC-type model
facts.value: Pdx1-Cre; LSL-KrasG12D/+; Trp53flox/wt mice sacrificed at 3 months of age show PanIN lesions surrounded by normal tissue in all three Ksr1 genotypes (the legend gives no grade)
Median age at sacrifice or death 159 days in Ksr1 wild-type/heterozygous controls (191 days in Ksr1-/-); tumours have moderately differentiated ductal morphology with stromal desmoplasia
Pdx1-CreLate; Dicerflox/+ (DicerHet) pancreas at 3 weeks has recognisable acini, ducts and islets (labelled A, D, I in Fig 1A)
At 3 weeks Kras; DicerHet pancreas shows only a rare focus of metaplasia and PanIN, whereas Dicer loss accelerated Kras-driven ADM
